stages.title: Vanilla agent loop
stages.sub: Every action blocks, and every image and check is its own model request.

stages.title: + Batched checks
stages.sub: A whole list of candidate poses is checked in one call.

stages.title: + Camera grid
stages.sub: All four cameras come back as one tiled image.

stages.title: + Same-step images
stages.sub: A program's pictures come back in the same tool call.

stages.title: + Automatic look
stages.sub: Each action ends with its result, state and camera grid: no turn to look.

stages.title: + Pipelining
stages.sub: Actions run in the background while the model plans the next ones.
